en.name: Freddy Hermawan Liwarto
en.quote: Giving direction, inspiring, listening, and leading the team to shared success.
en.intro: I am Freddy Liwarto, Director of PT SSI, I hope my leadership can provide innovation, quality and collaboration to provide the best results for the company, clients and business partners.

en.name: Sun Qifeng
en.quote: Work hard now, earn money now, until you get the climax of your success, then enjoy your achievement in the future.
en.intro: Hello, my name is Sun Qifeng. I am  as the Marketing Director in PT Surya Solusi International. My hobbies are doing exercise and enjoying culinary, which show the philosophical meaning about the balance in our life about effort and grateful. Hope we could achieve our dream together, to be the great team in PT Surya Solusi Internasional.

en.name: Li Weifeng
en.quote: A true leader's most important task is to inspire potential and help others become better people.
en.intro: Hello everyone, I am Li Weifeng, the General Manager of PT.SSI. I love life, am grateful for help, and actively challenge myself in new fields; providing high-quality, thoughtful, and cost-effective services to our clients is our company's consistent pursuit.

en.name: Rini Ariffiani
en.quote: Unity in harmony speaks up the teamwork performance. Make it strong but elegant
en.intro: Hi, I am Rini Ariffiani. I am the commissioner in PT Surya Solusi International. A great honor to be the part of PT Surya Solusi International. We could work, learn and grow together in the excellent team. Good team,good future and good achievement !

en.name: Abraham Christian Aji Wicaksono
en.quote: Setiap ruang memiliki cerita untuk diceritakan
en.intro: Hai! Nama saya Aji. Saya percaya bahwa alam adalah sumber inspirasi terbesar. Oleh karena itu, saya mengintegrasikan elemen-elemen alami ke dalam desain saya, menciptakan ruang yang harmonis dan menenangkan.

en.name: Iqbal Setyo Dewanto
en.quote: As you start to walk on the way, the way appears
en.intro: Hi, I'm Iqbal, a Structural Engineer. With my strong background and passion for structural design, I always strive for excellence and collaborative success in my projects.

en.name: Deng Chenglin
en.quote: Structures not only support buildings but also carry safety and trust.
en.intro: I am a professional passionate about structural engineering, skilled in applying engineering mechanics and innovative technologies to provide efficient, safe, and economical structural solutions for every project. I believe that precise calculations and reasonable designs can add greater value to buildings.

en.name: Li Jinyang
en.quote: Architectural Poetics, Social Value, Future Vision: The Resonance Between Humanity and Space
en.intro: Hello, I’m Li Jinyang, With 20+ years of expertise in both architectural creativity and rigorous construction execution, I design spaces that serve as a medium for emotional and social connection. I believe architecture acts as a continuously evolving life form.

en.name: Zheng Ping
en.quote: Building is a necessity; optimizing architecture is an art.
en.intro: Hello, I'm Zheng Ping. I design with a focus on implementation. By integrating architectural creativity with structural engineering, I ensure that every concept is grounded in reality—balancing visual impact with safety, cost control, and construction feasibility

en.name: Wijiyanto
en.quote: Bekerja bukan hanya tentang mencari nafkah, tetapi tentang membangun nilai, meninggalkan jejak yang baik, dan terus belajar menjadi lebih baik setiap harinya.
en.intro: Saya adalah seorang lulusan arsitektur dengan pengalaman lebih dari 10 tahun di bidang konstruksi, khususnya dalam pengawasan proyek. Selama karier saya, saya telah terlibat dalam berbagai jenis pembangunan, mulai dari kawasan industri, perumahan, gedung perkantoran, sekolah, hingga infrastruktur lainnya.

en.name: M. Nur Abdul Bashirudin
en.quote: Kerja cerdas, tidak banyak bicara
en.intro: Halo, saya Abas seorang Structural Engineer di PT. Surya Solusi Internasional, saya berusaha untuk selalu bekerja cerdas, cepat, tepat. Dengan kolaborasi antara Engineer Indonesia China menghasilkan sebuah karya yang luar biasa, kita terus berkembang maju untuk masa depan pembangunan Indonesia.

en.name: Tantya Galuh Puspa
en.quote: Good architectural design is not just about aesthetics, but about how a space can communicate, interact, and function perfectly.
en.intro: Hi, my name is Tantya Galuh. I am an architecture graduate and work at PT Surya Solusi Internasional as an architect. With my educational background and experience, I am committed to continuously learning and growing in the field of planning as well as other areas of construction, while striving to give my best for the company.

en.name: Sabilya Mahardika Saputri
en.quote: Great structures are built on strong foundations—both in engineering and in life
en.intro: Hai, I am Sabilya Mahardika Saputri, a Structural Engineer at PT Surya Solusi International. I am someone who always strives to grow and learn from every experience. I believe that every process has value and offers valuable lessons. For me, teamwork and effective communication are the keys to achieving optimal results, both in work and daily life.

en.name: Anis Salma
en.quote: Hope and change are forged through relentless effort. Never stop at one point, always strive for more
en.intro: Hello, my name is Anis Salma Al Fridasari, a Structural Engineer at PT. SSI, specializing in the design and analysis of building structures to ensure their strength and safety. With a solid educational background and experience, I am also committed to continually learning and developing in the construction field to provide the best and most sustainable solutions.

en.name: Rahmad Banu Hendrawan
en.quote: Don't be preoccupied with a single spot. See everything in it's entirety, effortlessly. That is what it means to truly see
en.intro: Greetings, Hi, I'm Banuk, a junior architect with a strong interest in thoughtful, sustainable design. I'm passionate about turning creative ideas into functional spaces and continuously learning to grow in the field of architecture.

en.name: Marchelina Eka Sofyani
en.quote: Every line drawn carries purpose. It shapes experiences and leaves a lasting mark
en.intro: Hi! I’m Marchelina, a change-driven learner who’s always eager to grow and continually improve my skills. I’m committed to contributing and delivering my best to PT SSI.

en.name: Muhammad Fadillah
en.quote: Keep learning and Innovates, Less Complaining and More Action, keep striving for success
en.intro: Halo, Im Muh. Fadillah, as junior Architect. i hope my capability can contribute for the company. I believe an idiom 'you will get what you are fighting for'

en.name: Ign. Kurniawan Eko Wibowo
en.quote: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
en.intro: Hi! I'm Wawan, and my life's a constant quest for knowledge. I'm fascinated by everything, always eager to learn and explore new ideas.

en.name: Lafifatul Badhriyah
en.quote: Pekerjaan adalah amanah, profesional dalam bekerja adalah pelaksanaan amanah tersebut.
en.intro: Halo. Saya Lafifatul Badhriyah, admin dari PT. Surya Solusi Internasional. Proses perkembangan perusahaan merupakan inspirasi untuk  menambah pengalaman dan motivasi bagi saya. Tanggung jawab, jujur, dan cekatan adalah bagian dari profesionalisme kerja yang saya terapkan.

en.name: Ahmad Sugiyanto
en.quote: When you declutter, you create space for new opportunities.
en.intro: Hi there! I’m Ahmad Sugiyanto. I believe that cleanliness is not just about keeping our physical spaces tidy; it’s a reflection of our mental and emotional state. Drawing inspiration from Stoic philosophy, I embrace the idea that we should focus on what we can control and accept what we cannot.

zh.name: Freddy Hermawan Liwarto
zh.quote: 给予方向，激励，倾听，并引导团队走向共同的成功。
zh.intro: 我是Freddy Hermawan Liwarto，PT SSI的董事，我希望我的领导能够提供创新、质量和合作，为公司、客户和商业伙伴提供最佳结果。

zh.name: 孙启丰
zh.quote: 现在努力工作，现在赚钱，直到你达到成功的巅峰，然后享受未来的成就。
zh.intro: 大家好，我是孙启丰，PT Surya Solusi International的市场总监。我热爱运动和美食，这体现了我对生活平衡的哲学思考——努力与感恩并重。希望我们携手共进，共创PT Surya Solusi International辉煌未来。

zh.name: 李伟锋
zh.quote: 真正的领导者最需要做的是激发潜能，帮助他人成为更好的人。
zh.intro: 大家好，我是李伟锋，PT.SSI的总经理。热爱生活，感恩帮助，积极挑战新领域是我的个人宗旨；为客户提供优质、贴心和有性价比的服务，是我们企业的一贯追求。

zh.name: Rini Ariffiani
zh.quote: 和谐中的团结提升团队合作表现。让它强大而优雅。
zh.intro: 嗨，我是Rini Ariffiani。我是PT Surya Solusi International的委员。能够成为PT Surya Solusi International的一部分是我莫大的荣幸。我们可以在优秀的团队中一起工作、学习和成长。好的团队，好的未来，好的成就！

zh.name: Abraham Christian Aji Wicaksono
zh.quote: 每个空间都有故事可讲。
zh.intro: 你好！我叫阿吉。我相信自然是最大的灵感来源。因此，我将自然元素融入我的设计中，创造出和谐而宁静的空间。

zh.name: Iqbal Setyo Dewanto
zh.quote: 当你开始走在路上，路就会出现。
zh.intro: 大家好，我叫Iqbal，是一名结构工程师。凭借扎实的结构设计基础和对工程的热情，我始终在每一个项目中追求卓越。我重视合作，并坚信最好的成果源于团队合作与共同的成功。。

zh.name: 邓成林
zh.quote: 结构不仅支撑建筑，也承载着安全与信任。
zh.intro: 我是一名热衷于结构工程的专业人士，擅长运用工程力学和创新技术，为每一个项目提供高效、安全、经济的结构解决方案。我相信精确的计算与合理的设计能够为建筑赋予更高的价值。

zh.name: 李金洋
zh.quote: 雾烟暗遮世外天。
zh.intro: 您好，我是李金阳，一名结构工程师，在安全、高效和可持续结构设计和分析方面拥有深厚的专业知识。我热衷于将复杂的工程挑战转化为切实可行的解决方案，并乐于与建筑师和其他专业人士合作，将创新设计变为现实。

zh.name: 郑平
zh.quote: 人们为了生活而建造，为了更好的生活而优化建筑。
zh.intro: 我是一名同时具备建筑设计与结构设计能力的设计师，擅长从‘建筑落地’的角度做设计：既能用建筑语言表达空间、美学与功能需求，也能同步用结构思维把控安全、成本与施工可行性。

zh.name: Wijiyanto
zh.quote: 工作不仅仅是为了谋生，而是为了建立价值，留下良好的印记，并不断学习每天变得更好。
zh.intro: 我是一名建筑专业毕业生，在建筑领域有超过10年的施工经验，特别是在项目监督方面。在我的职业生涯中，我参与了各种类型的建设，从工业区、住宅、办公楼、学校到其他基础设施。

zh.name: M. Nur Abdul Bashirudin
zh.quote: 聪明工作，不多说。
zh.intro: 你好，我是Abas，PT. Surya Solusi Internasional的结构工程师，我努力始终工作聪明、快速、准确。通过印尼和中国工程师之间的合作，创造出卓越的作品，我们不断向前发展，为印尼的建设未来而努力。

zh.name: Tantya Galuh Puspa Hendika
zh.quote: 好的建筑设计不仅仅是美学，而是空间如何完美地沟通、互动和运作。
zh.intro: 大家好，我叫 Tantya Galuh。我是一名建筑学毕业生，目前在 PT Surya Solusi Internasional 担任建筑师。凭借我的教育背景和经验，我致力于在规划和其他建筑领域不断学习和成长，同时努力为公司提供最佳服务。

zh.name: Sabilya Mahardika Saputri
zh.quote: 伟大的结构建立在坚实的基础上——无论是在工程还是生活中。
zh.intro: 嗨，我是Sabilya Mahardika Saputri，PT Surya Solusi International的结构工程师。我是一个始终努力从每次经历中成长和学习的人。我相信每个过程都有其价值，并提供宝贵的经验。对我来说，团队合作和有效沟通是实现最佳结果的关键，无论是在工作还是日常生活中。

zh.name: Anis Salma
zh.quote: 希望和变化是通过不懈的努力锻造的。永远不要停留在一个点上，总是追求更多。
zh.intro: 你好，我的名字是Anis Salma Al Fridasari，PT. SSI的结构工程师，专注于建筑结构的设计和分析，以确保其强度和安全性。凭借扎实的教育背景和经验，我也致力于在建筑领域不断学习和发展，以提供最佳和最可持续的解决方案。

zh.name: Rahmad Banu Hendrawan
zh.quote: 不要只关注一个点。轻松地看待一切的整体。这才是真正的视野。
zh.intro: 大家好，我叫Banuk，是一名初级建筑师。我对周到且可持续的设计充满兴趣，热衷于将创意理念转化为实用空间，并不断学习，以在建筑领域不断成长。

zh.name: Marchelina Eka Sofyani
zh.quote: 落笔之处，皆有深意。它塑造体验，亦铭刻恒久印记。
zh.intro: 大家好，我是 Marchelina。作为一名拥抱变化的终身学习者，我始终追求自我突破与精进。我将全力以赴，为 PT SSI 贡献我的最佳价值。

zh.name: Muhammad Fadillah
zh.quote: 持续学习，锐意创新。少一点抱怨，多一份实干。为成功不懈奋斗。
zh.intro: 大家好，我是 Muh. Fadillah，一名初级建筑师。希望以此微薄之力，为公司创造价值。我坚信一句格言：“功夫不负有心人，付出必有回报。

zh.name: Ign. Kurniawan Eko Wibowo
zh.quote: 你能掌控自己的思想，而非外在环境。明白这一点，你就能获得力量。
zh.intro: 嗨，我是Wawan，我的人生是一场持续不断的知识追求。我对一切事物都着迷，总是渴望学习和探索新的想法。

zh.name: Lafifatul Badhriyah
zh.quote: 工作是一种信任，专业的工作是对这种信任的履行。
zh.intro: 你好。我是Lafifatul Badhriyah，PT. Surya Solusi Internasional的管理员。公司的发展过程是我增加经验和动力的灵感。责任、诚实和敏捷是我在工作中应用的专业精神。

zh.name: Ahmad Sugiyanto
zh.quote: 当你清理杂物时，你为新的机会创造了空间。
zh.intro: 嗨！我是Ahmad Sugiyanto。我相信，清洁不仅仅是保持我们物理空间的整洁；它反映了我们的心理和情感状态。受到斯多葛哲学的启发，我接受了我们应该专注于我们能控制的事物，并接受我们无法控制的事物的想法。
